title: Settings
description: Rules of {school}. Times are Morocco time (Africa/Casablanca).

sections.calendar_hint: School days and school year dates (holidays are generated within this period).
sections.menus_hint: Values proposed for each new week; editable week by week. Weeks already created keep their times.
sections.notifications_hint: In-app notifications are always created; these settings only affect emails.
sections.kitchen_hint: A4 label sheet layout (default 3 × 8, i.e. 70 × 37 mm).
sections.modules_hint: A disabled module disappears from the app and its rules stop applying. Its data is kept and comes back if you turn it on again.

fields.edit_cutoff_days_before_hint: 0 = the same day, 1 = the day before.
fields.auto_assign_default_meal: At the deadline, give the default dish to subscribed children with no choice
fields.allergy_rule: Meal containing one of the child's allergens
fields.supplement_max_quantity: Maximum quantity per supplement, per child and per day
fields.subscription_meal_price_hint: Used to calculate the revenue. Statements and parents are not concerned. A change also applies to past days. Left empty: 50 MAD.
fields.subscription_required_for_main_meal: The main dish requires an active subscription
fields.edit_cutoff_days_before_not_applicable: Not applicable in same-day mode: only today's meal can be changed, before the cutoff time.
fields.delivery_order_url_hint: Full address starting with https://. Left empty, the button does not appear in the parent space.
fields.glovo_url_hint: Full address starting with https://. Left empty, the button does not appear in the parent space.
fields.support_whatsapp_hint: With the country code, for example +212 6 12 34 56 78. Left empty, the WhatsApp icon does not appear in the parent space.
fields.allergens_enabled_hint: Meal allergens and children's allergies: blocking or confirmation when ordering, allergy sheet, mentions on screens, labels and exports. When off, no allergy check is done when ordering.
fields.labels_enabled_hint: Kitchen Labels page and printable PDF.
fields.grade_enabled_hint: Children's grade: forms, lists, production breakdown, labels, exports and statements.
fields.class_enabled_hint: Children's class: forms, filters, production breakdown, labels, exports and statements.
fields.printer_hint: 80 mm thermal printer (ESC/POS, e.g. Rongta RP332A) to print the day’s tickets from Kitchen › Exports.

printer_modes.off_hint: No print button; the tickets stay available as PDF.
printer_modes.direct_hint: The server sends the tickets to the printer’s network address (port 9100). The server must be on the printer’s network, or linked by VPN.
printer_modes.agent_hint: The “Print” button queues the tickets; a small program (the agent) installed on a PC of the kitchen’s network sends them to the printer. Steps below.

fields.printer_host_hint: IP address of the printer on the kitchen’s network (printed on its self-test page: hold FEED while powering on).

errors.school_year_range: The end must be after the start (400 days at most).
errors.deadline_before_publish: The deadline must be after the publication (in the week before).
errors.board_slug_taken: This address is already used by another school.

api.title: Revenue API
api.hint: Lets another app read the revenue of each day: subscription meals × the amount of one meal, plus the extras.
api.usage: Parameters: ?date=YYYY-MM-DD, or ?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD (366 days at most). No parameter: today. Headers: X-Api-Key and X-Api-Secret.
api.secret_hint: Keep it on the server side: never put it in a web page or a mobile app.
api.secret_error: The secret key cannot be displayed. Generate new keys.
api.confirm_body: The current keys will stop working immediately. The other app will have to be updated.

board.title: School screen
board.hint: A page to open on a screen at the school (no login): the menu of the week, day by day, with the photos of the dishes and supplements, in big format and animated. It shows the published menu only (what parents already see), never orders or children.
board.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (3 to 80 characters).
board.link: Link to open on the screen
board.disable_body: The page stops working at once.
board.printer_button: Show the “Connect the printer” button on the screen
board.printer_button_hint: Keep it shown while you pair the screen’s USB printer (once), then untick so children no longer see it: the printer stays paired.

printer_agent.title: Install the agent on the kitchen PC (once)
printer_agent.step_save: Fill in the printer address above and save the settings; generate the API keys (the “API” card below) if not done yet.
printer_agent.step_download: Download the two files into a folder on the PC (e.g. C:\bfk):
printer_agent.env_warning: print-agent.env holds the secret key: do not share it or e-mail it. The third file is only for a Linux PC (automatic installation).
printer_agent.step_node: Install Node.js (LTS version) on that PC, from
printer_agent.step_run: Open a command prompt in the folder and run:
printer_agent.step_autostart: To start it by itself: Windows → Task Scheduler, new task “at logon”, action “node C:\bfk\print-agent.mjs C:\bfk\print-agent.env”. Linux → “sudo bash print-agent-install.sh” installs a service that starts at boot.
printer_agent.step_test: Test: Kitchen › Exports › “Print on the receipt printer”. The line goes from “Queued” to “Printed” within seconds. If you regenerate the API keys, download print-agent.env again.
printer_agent.no_keys: Generate the API keys first (“Revenue API” card).
